title: GABInsight: Exploring Gender-Activity Binding Bias in Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating image-to-text and text-to-image retrieval accuracy on a custom dataset (GAB) to measure how Vision-Language Models associate specific activities with expected versus unexpected genders, particularly comparing single-person scenes against complex scenes containing two individuals of different genders. Additionally, measuring text encoder bias by comparing the cosine similarity of gender-neutral sentence embeddings to gender-specific ones.
